name: Dynamic Team Manager – Team Members, Staff Directory, Grid & Slider
author: Maidul

sections.description:
Dynamic Team Manager lets you add your people once (photo, name, job title, short and long bio, contact details, social links, skills, gallery) and show them anywhere on your site as a grid, list, slider or table. Use it for a company “Meet the team” page, a staff directory, a school or club roster, or a speaker list.

You choose how to display the team:

  • Shortcode generator: build a layout in the admin, copy the shortcode, paste it into any page, post or widget.
  • Gutenberg block: insert the Team block in the block editor.
  • Elementor widget: drag the Team widget onto a page and style it with Elementor’s controls. The widget also has a table layout.

Everything is shown or hidden field by field, so the same members can appear as a simple photo grid on one page and a full profile list on another.

Live demo | Documentation | Support

What you can do with the free plugin

  • Add unlimited team members with a built-in “Team” post type, plus team groups to sort them.
  • Show members in grid, list and slider layouts (shortcode and block) and grid, list, slider and table layouts (Elementor widget).
  • Set columns for desktop, tablet and mobile, number of members, order, and which members to include or exclude by ID.
  • Show or hide each element: photo, name, job title, short bio, contact details, social icons, skills.
  • Style the cards: spacing, borders, radius, colours, image size and hover effect, and social icon colours and position.
  • Slider settings: autoplay, speed, slides to scroll, pause on hover, arrows, dots, auto height.
  • Link each member to a single page with the full profile, or turn the link off.
  • Import and export members as CSV.
  • Sports League mode: switch the admin and front-end labels from “Job title” to “Position”, “Location” to “Jersey number” and “Departments” to “Teams” in one setting. It changes labels only; your data stays the same.
  • Optional automations: send a Telegram message when a member is added or updated, or send the member data to a webhook you control (for example n8n, to reach Google Sheets or Airtable).
  • Translatable, with developer hooks for changing the output.

Pro add-on (separate paid plan)

  • Live search and taxonomy filters on the front end.
  • More layout options and styling options.
  • Slack updates, an AI FAQ bot (needs your own OpenAI-compatible key) and an onboarding page generator.

Details and pricing: WP Team Manager Pro.

Fields available for each member

  • Name, short bio, long bio (rich text editor), job title
  • Email, office telephone, mobile, location, years of experience
  • Social profile links
  • Skills with a name and a percentage
  • Gallery of extra images

How to start

  1. Go to Team > Add New and add a member.
  2. Open the shortcode generator under the Team menu, choose a layout and copy the shortcode.
  3. Paste it into a page. Or add the Team block, or the Elementor Team widget.

Demos: Grid | Slider | List | Elementor widget | Elementor table layout | Sports league

Video: How to install | How to add a team member

External services

This plugin works without contacting any outside service. These optional features do:

Freemius (account, updates and optional usage data)

The plugin includes the Freemius SDK and shows its opt-in screen. If you opt in, Freemius receives basic site and plugin information (such as your site URL, WordPress and PHP versions, the plugin version and your admin email) so it can provide the account area, updates and support. If you skip the opt-in, no usage data is sent. Service: https://freemius.com. Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/. Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/.

Telegram (optional)

If you enter a bot token and chat ID under Team > AI Agents > Telegram Notifier and switch the module on, the plugin sends a message to api.telegram.org each time a published team member is added or updated. The message contains the member’s name and the link to the member’s page, plus your bot token and chat ID, which Telegram needs to deliver it. Nothing is sent until you configure it. Service: https://telegram.org. Terms and privacy: https://telegram.org/privacy.

Webhook / Profile Sync (optional)

If you enter a webhook URL under Team > AI Agents > Profile Sync Agent, the plugin sends that URL a JSON message each time a team member is added or updated (by default only published members). It contains the member’s title, link, excerpt, featured image URL, author name, your site name and URL, and the member’s custom field values that are not protected (this includes contact details such as email and phone if you have filled them in). The URL belongs to you (for example your n8n server); the plugin author does not receive this data. Terms and privacy depend on the service behind the URL you choose.

YouTube (admin screen only)

The Team > Tools screen embeds a YouTube tutorial video. YouTube may set cookies when the video loads. Nothing is loaded on the public side of your site. Terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms. Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload wp-team-manager to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. A new Team tab will be available in the admin section
sections.faq:
How do I show my team on a page?

Add your members under Team > Add New. Then open the shortcode generator under the Team menu, choose a layout, copy the shortcode and paste it into a page. You can also insert the Team block in the block editor, or use the Team widget in Elementor.

Which layouts are free?

Grid, list and slider in the shortcode generator and the block. The Elementor widget adds a table layout. Live search and taxonomy filters are part of the Pro plan.

How do I show only some members, for example one team group?

In the shortcode generator choose the team group, or enter the member IDs to include or exclude. The ID of each member is in the ID column of the Team list.

Can I turn the link from the photo to the member page off?

Yes. Switch it off in the plugin settings under Team > Settings.

I run a sports team or a club. Can I use it for a roster?

Yes. Go to Team > Settings > General and set Dashboard Mode to Sports League. Labels such as Job Title, Location and Departments become Position, Jersey Number and Teams. Only the labels change; there are no statistics or fixtures, and your data stays unchanged when you switch back. Developers can add their own modes with the wp_team_manager_dashboard_presets filter.

Does it work with my theme and my page builder?

It works with themes that follow WordPress standards, with the block editor, and with Elementor. The shortcode also works in the classic editor and in widget areas.

Where can I see the team member ID?

In the ID column of the team members list.

How can I change the image size of team members?

Team Manager lists all available image sizes. To change default image sizes, go to Settings > Media.

Can I import my team from a spreadsheet?

Yes. Under Team > Import/Export you can export members to CSV and import a CSV file again. Check the exported file for the exact columns before preparing your own.

Does the plugin send data to other sites?

Not unless you turn it on. Optional features contact outside services: the Freemius account screen (only if you opt in), Telegram notifications and the webhook sync (only if you enter a bot token or webhook URL). See the External services section.

How do I enable the Telegram Notifier?

Go to Team > AI Agents > Telegram Notifier.
Enter your Telegram Bot Token and Chat ID. You can create a bot using @BotFather and get the chat ID from @userinfobot. Once saved, new or updated team members will trigger a message to your Telegram group or channel.

How do I sync team member data to Google Sheets or Airtable?

Use the Profile Sync Agent (free).
1. Sign up for a free n8n account or install it on your server.
2. Create a webhook workflow in n8n that sends data to Google Sheets or Airtable.
3. Paste the webhook URL into the Profile Sync Agent settings.
Every time a team member is added or updated, the data will be sent to your automation workflow.

Do I need OpenAI API keys for all AI Agents?

No. Only AI-powered modules like the FAQ Bot (Pro) require an OpenAI (or compatible) API key.
Modules such as the Telegram Notifier or Profile Sync Agent don’t require AI credits.

Can I disable the automations if I don’t need them?

Yes. Leave their settings blank and they won’t run.

How can I troubleshoot if the automations are not working?

  • Enable debug logging in Team > Settings > Advanced > Enable Debug Log.
  • Check the generated log file for errors (path shown in settings).
  • Make sure your bot token and webhook URLs are correct.

Where do I get help?

Open a thread in the support forum on WordPress.org, or send a request at https://dynamicweblab.com/submit-a-request/.
sections.changelog:
2.6.9

  • Security: Fixed Broken Access Control / CSRF (CVE-2025-58222) — the bundled Freemius SDK reset the usage-tracking opt-in (“reset anonymous mode”) from a plain link, with no nonce or capability check, so a crafted link or a logged-out request could reset it. It now requires an administrator and a confirmed, nonce-protected request
  • Security: Hardening — unauthenticated requests can no longer make the plugin write files or settings (the generated team.css was rewritten on every page view; role capabilities, the post-update routine and migration scheduling could be triggered by logged-out admin-ajax.php requests)
  • Security: Debug log is now stored under a non-guessable file name in a folder that blocks web access, and no longer records webhook signatures or member contact details; custom log paths must end in .log
  • Security: CSV export neutralises spreadsheet formulas (cells starting with =, +, -, @), which also keeps phone numbers like +1-555… intact in Excel
  • Security: “Open links in new window” now adds rel=”noopener noreferrer”
  • Fix: “Open links in new window” produced a broken target attribute, so links reused one named tab
  • Fix: A CSV exported by the plugin can now be imported again (the file’s UTF-8 BOM made the header check fail)
  • Fix: Elementor Team widget “Read More” button now shows by default and hides when single member view is disabled (the condition was inverted in every layout)
  • Fix: Elementor Team widget List Style 3 (Pro) links the photo and Read More to the member page only when single view is enabled
  • Fix: Elementor Team widget Load More now respects the widget’s “By Keyword” and “Date Range” settings
  • Fix: Elementor Team widget Load More no longer repeats members (Limit -1, Limit above 100) and is hidden when there is nothing more to load
  • Fix: Elementor Team widget live search no longer swaps content between two widgets on the same page
  • Fix: Clearing a live search restores the widget’s page and Load More state, so Load More doesn’t repeat members
  • Fix: Load More keeps the widget’s own button text after the first click
  • Fix: Elementor Team widget number pagination counts pages from the same query as the listing
  • Fix: Trashed, unpublished or deleted team members disappear from listings right away (they stayed for up to an hour); edits to members, their fields and their groups also show immediately, including on sites with Redis/Memcached object caching and edits made via REST or WP-CLI
  • Fix: Number pagination highlights the right page on a static front page, and the Elementor Team widget paginates there
  • Fix: Team Manager block “Columns” setting is applied (grid and slider showed 2 / 4 columns regardless); new Gap control; block alignment, color, spacing and typography settings now apply
  • Fix: Team Manager block “Groups” dropdown lists the groups when the editor opens
  • Fix: “Team Directory” block pattern rendered a grid; it now uses the list layout (the block has no table layout). Removed the block’s Style option, which had no effect
  • Fix: Elementor Team slider animates at normal speed; “Autoplay Speed” is now only the pause between slides, and an empty value no longer makes the slider spin out of control
  • Fix: Elementor Team slider marks the correct slides as active (column counts were passed as text)
  • Fix: Elementor Team slider “Transition Effect: Fade” now works when one slide is shown, and “Lazy Loading: No” loads all slide images right away
  • Fix: Team Generator slider keeps the Dot navigation and Mobile Columns settings on tablets and small phones
  • Fix: Slider arrows point the right way: the left arrow goes back and the right arrow goes forward
  • Fix: Team Generator “Custom CSS” (Pro) is now applied, scoped to that team
  • Fix: Team Generator styles are written once on save instead of on every page view, so team.css is cached by browsers and no longer overwritten by each visitor
  • Fix: Team Generator “Theme Preset” is no longer overridden by the Card Shadow setting; “Extra Large” shadow now works
  • Fix: Team Generator “Custom Value” for Card Border Radius and Grid Gap is now applied
  • Fix: Team Generator “Rounded” image style now rounds images
  • Fix: Editors saving a Team Generator now update its styles
  • Fix: List Style 1 respects “Hide Short Bio”; Grid Style 4 respects the image size and the disabled single member view
  • Fix: Table Style 1 no longer prints the short bio twice; Table Style 2 respects Read More, “Hide Other Info”, phone-link and single member view settings
  • Fix: [team_manager] shortcode hides Read More when single member view is disabled
  • Fix: Email social profile links now open a valid mailto: address; phone profile links use clean tel: numbers
  • Fix: Field Visibility (Pro) now lists Resume and Hire Me URLs (they were hidden as soon as any field was selected), and unticking every field hides them all instead of showing everything
  • Fix: Gallery Lightbox, Hide Single Thumbnail and other Pro settings no longer stop working on sites with a persistent object cache
  • Fix: Clicking a gallery image does nothing when Gallery Lightbox is off (Pro) — the image now opens normally
  • Fix: Single member pages on free sites no longer load the full-size original photo after saving settings
  • Fix: Custom vCard / Web URL link text no longer shows the admin field name (“Add vCard File”); the vCard button defaults to “Download vCard”
  • Fix: Popup phone numbers are clickable like on the single page; the popup “Read More” opens the member page (and is hidden when single view is disabled)
  • Fix: YouTube and other embeds in the Long Bio are no longer removed, and other plugins’ content add-ons no longer appear inside it
  • Fix: SEO JSON-LD (Pro) now includes the member’s job title and social profile links
  • Fix: Team member pages no longer return 404 after activating the plugin (rewrite rules were flushed before the post type was registered)
  • Fix: Changing the Team Member Slug or enabling/disabling a taxonomy now updates permalinks right away (the deferred flush never ran)
  • Fix: Deactivating the plugin now removes its permalinks
  • Fix: Deleting a Team Generator no longer stops with an “Unauthorized access.” screen for Editors
  • Fix: Team archive on block themes (e.g. Twenty Twenty-Four/Five) keeps the theme header, footer and block settings, and can be customised in the Site Editor; removed the temporary template file that could cause blank pages
  • Fix: Two Team Generators with number pagination on the same page no longer change pages together (each uses its own ?wtm_page_ID parameter)
  • Fix: The same Team Generator placed twice on a page keeps unique element IDs, separate searches and its styles on both copies
  • Fix: Team members loaded with Load More, a filter or a search get the same screen-reader roles and image alt text as the first page

  • Fix: Team Generator filter buttons only show groups that have members in the generator’s results (Include/Exclude Terms, selected groups, member IDs, keyword and dates), so no button leads to an empty list
  • Security: [team_manager] color attributes (bg_color, social_color) only accept real color values; arbitrary CSS could be injected into the page
  • Fix: [team_manager] grid showed empty cards on Windows servers
  • Fix: A theme override of the team list/grid/slider templates no longer stops the page with “Invalid template file.”
  • Fix: [team_manager] filter buttons only list the groups of the members shown, and filtering the list layout no longer hides every member
  • Fix: Random order is no longer cached for an hour (every visitor saw the same order)
  • Fix: [team_manager] shows all members by default (“0” from the Shortcode Generator limited it to the Reading setting) and no longer changes members on /page/2/ of archives
  • Fix: [team_manager] Order By “ID” works; Shortcode Generator lists every image size (medium, large, full…); columns=”5″ shows five per row; card background color applies to the slider
  • Fix: [team_manager] social icons keep their hover color unless a social color is set; grid cards are announced as a list to screen readers
  • Fix: Shortcode Generator output is safe to copy (quotes and brackets in values no longer break it), and a new Team Generator no longer offers an id=”0″ shortcode before it’s saved
  • Fix: Team Generator Slider Style 5 (Pro): clicking a member photo opened a broken address instead of the member page
  • Fix: Team Generator shows Style 1 instead of an empty section when the saved style isn’t available (e.g. a Pro style after Pro expired); Pro styles are only used while Pro is active
  • Fix: Team Generator Load More / Infinite Scroll are only shown while Pro is active (the button did nothing on free sites)
  • Fix: Team Generator Load More, filters and search no longer fail with an error on fully cached pages older than a day
  • Fix: Team Generator search or filter with no matches shows “No team members found” instead of a blank area, and the search result count is filled in
  • Fix: Team Generator filter, search and Load More no longer mix results when clicked quickly one after another
  • Fix: Team Generator Slider Style 3 (Pro) shows the Read More button
  • Fix: Team cards get the team member’s post classes instead of the page’s, so cards loaded with Load More look the same as the first page
  • Fix: Team Generator AJAX requests keep the page language with WPML; error and result-count texts are translatable; removed a console message
  • Fix: Turning an AI Agents module off and saving no longer erases its saved Telegram token, chat ID, webhook URL/secret, OpenAI key or Slack webhook

  • Fix: The onboarding setup guide notice appears on Team Manager screens, and its steps can be completed

short_description: Show team members, staff and sports rosters in grid, list, slider or table layouts. Shortcode generator, Gutenberg block and Elementor widget.
description:
Dynamic Team Manager lets you add your people once (photo, name, job title, short and long bio, contact details, social links, skills, gallery) and show them anywhere on your site as a grid, list, slider or table. Use it for a company “Meet the team” page, a staff directory, a school or club roster, or a speaker list.

You choose how to display the team:

  • Shortcode generator: build a layout in the admin, copy the shortcode, paste it into any page, post or widget.
  • Gutenberg block: insert the Team block in the block editor.
  • Elementor widget: drag the Team widget onto a page and style it with Elementor’s controls. The widget also has a table layout.

Everything is shown or hidden field by field, so the same members can appear as a simple photo grid on one page and a full profile list on another.

Live demo | Documentation | Support

What you can do with the free plugin

  • Add unlimited team members with a built-in “Team” post type, plus team groups to sort them.
  • Show members in grid, list and slider layouts (shortcode and block) and grid, list, slider and table layouts (Elementor widget).
  • Set columns for desktop, tablet and mobile, number of members, order, and which members to include or exclude by ID.
  • Show or hide each element: photo, name, job title, short bio, contact details, social icons, skills.
  • Style the cards: spacing, borders, radius, colours, image size and hover effect, and social icon colours and position.
  • Slider settings: autoplay, speed, slides to scroll, pause on hover, arrows, dots, auto height.
  • Link each member to a single page with the full profile, or turn the link off.
  • Import and export members as CSV.
  • Sports League mode: switch the admin and front-end labels from “Job title” to “Position”, “Location” to “Jersey number” and “Departments” to “Teams” in one setting. It changes labels only; your data stays the same.
  • Optional automations: send a Telegram message when a member is added or updated, or send the member data to a webhook you control (for example n8n, to reach Google Sheets or Airtable).
  • Translatable, with developer hooks for changing the output.

Pro add-on (separate paid plan)

  • Live search and taxonomy filters on the front end.
  • More layout options and styling options.
  • Slack updates, an AI FAQ bot (needs your own OpenAI-compatible key) and an onboarding page generator.

Details and pricing: WP Team Manager Pro.

Fields available for each member

  • Name, short bio, long bio (rich text editor), job title
  • Email, office telephone, mobile, location, years of experience
  • Social profile links
  • Skills with a name and a percentage
  • Gallery of extra images

How to start

  1. Go to Team > Add New and add a member.
  2. Open the shortcode generator under the Team menu, choose a layout and copy the shortcode.
  3. Paste it into a page. Or add the Team block, or the Elementor Team widget.

Demos: Grid | Slider | List | Elementor widget | Elementor table layout | Sports league

Video: How to install | How to add a team member

External services

This plugin works without contacting any outside service. These optional features do:

Freemius (account, updates and optional usage data)

The plugin includes the Freemius SDK and shows its opt-in screen. If you opt in, Freemius receives basic site and plugin information (such as your site URL, WordPress and PHP versions, the plugin version and your admin email) so it can provide the account area, updates and support. If you skip the opt-in, no usage data is sent. Service: https://freemius.com. Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/. Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/.

Telegram (optional)

If you enter a bot token and chat ID under Team > AI Agents > Telegram Notifier and switch the module on, the plugin sends a message to api.telegram.org each time a published team member is added or updated. The message contains the member’s name and the link to the member’s page, plus your bot token and chat ID, which Telegram needs to deliver it. Nothing is sent until you configure it. Service: https://telegram.org. Terms and privacy: https://telegram.org/privacy.

Webhook / Profile Sync (optional)

If you enter a webhook URL under Team > AI Agents > Profile Sync Agent, the plugin sends that URL a JSON message each time a team member is added or updated (by default only published members). It contains the member’s title, link, excerpt, featured image URL, author name, your site name and URL, and the member’s custom field values that are not protected (this includes contact details such as email and phone if you have filled them in). The URL belongs to you (for example your n8n server); the plugin author does not receive this data. Terms and privacy depend on the service behind the URL you choose.

YouTube (admin screen only)

The Team > Tools screen embeds a YouTube tutorial video. YouTube may set cookies when the video loads. Nothing is loaded on the public side of your site. Terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms. Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy.
